subject: MBTA Bus Route Redesign
overview: The Medford Human Rights Commission approved past minutes, voted to disband an internal subcommittee, and discussed the community impacts of proposed MBTA bus route changes.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The commission approved the meeting minutes from prior meetings.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Updates and Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The commission discussed virtual meeting regulations under the Open Meeting Law and agreed to take August off before inviting applicants to the September meeting.

items.title: Boston Bangla Festival Announcement
items.summary: Frances Nwajei shared details regarding the Boston Bangla Festival scheduled at Andrews Field on July 23.

items.title: Disbanding of HRC Subcommittee
items.summary: The commission voted to officially disband its charter subcommittee.

items.title: Discussion on Proposed MBTA Bus Route Redesign
items.summary: Members discussed proposed MBTA bus route cuts, raising equity and accessibility concerns regarding transit access for West Medford, seniors, public housing residents, and Medford Square.
